Use case: precise-object-edit / typographic alignment correction.
Edit the supplied existing TVSI Helpdesk OG artwork. Make ONE precise change: align the word "Helpdesk" directly underneath the "TVSI" wordmark as a perfectly aligned typographic column.
The LEFT visible edge of H must align exactly vertically with the LEFT visible edge of the T above. The RIGHT visible edge of k must align exactly vertically with the RIGHT visible edge of the I above. In the supplied 1731x909 reference these TVSI boundaries are approximately x=687 and x=1369; Helpdesk currently begins too far left at x=657 and ends early. Move Helpdesk slightly right and adjust its scale or spacing subtly so both outer edges match TVSI. Keep the same humanist sans typeface, weight, color, height as close as possible, physical material and baseline. Keep a comfortable unchanged vertical gap. Preserve the full official circular TVSI emblem, the TVSI wordmark itself, their original positions, precise logo shapes, background, lighting, shadows, camera, framing and overall dimensions. Do not center Helpdesk under the entire logo-plus-wordmark; it belongs ONLY under the black TVSI letters.
Everything outside the Helpdesk text region must remain unchanged. No new elements, no guides or alignment lines in the final image. No slogans. Exact text stays "TVSI" and "Helpdesk". Deliver the corrected image, landscape 1200:630 aspect ratio.

Make a very precise typographic correction to this image. The "Helpdesk" line is currently too far to the RIGHT. Its H begins at approximately x=735, but the actual OUTERMOST LEFT EDGE of the T's TOP HORIZONTAL BAR above is at x=687. Align H with the outermost left edge of the TOP BAR of T, NOT with T's vertical stem. Move H and the Helpdesk line 48 pixels left at this source resolution. Increase the letter spacing across the word slightly so the final k still ends exactly under the right edge of the I above (x=1368). Thus both black text rows must occupy the SAME horizontal bounds x=687 through x=1368. This is a strict left-and-right edge alignment, like two rectangles of equal width stacked vertically. Do NOT align H to the narrower vertical stem of T. No alignment guide lines should appear in the output.
Keep the word "Helpdesk" on its current baseline and preserve its font, letter height, material and lighting. Preserve the emblem, the TVSI wordmark, background, camera and all other elements unchanged. Do not add anything. Same landscape aspect ratio and framing.

Precise final alignment correction only. Keep the entire supplied image unchanged except the horizontal placement/spacing of the word Helpdesk. The outer dark pixel bounds of the TVSI line are x=686 through x=1368 on this 1731-pixel-wide image. The Helpdesk line currently spans x=697 through x=1371. Correct it to span x=686 through x=1368, by moving the LEFT EDGE of the H 11 pixels left and the RIGHT EDGE of the k 3 pixels left, distributing the tiny width change as spacing across the letters. H must start at the vertical line through the far left tip of T's top bar. The two lines must have exactly the same left and right alignment. Preserve font size vertically, baseline, weight, material, shadows, the emblem, the TVSI wordmark, background, lighting and composition. Do not align with the vertical stem of T. Do not add any guides, decorations or text. This is a tiny 11-pixel correction, no redesign or reframing.
